title: This Bird Digests Like a Cow, Smells Like One, and Hatches With Claws
subject: hoatzin

scenes.text: This bird digests its food like a cow. It even smells like one.
The hoatzin eats leaves, and almost no bird can digest those well.
So it ferments them in an oversized crop, with bacteria, just like a cow's stomach. No other bird does this.
The result is a manure smell, which is why it is called the stinkbird. Predators stay away.
Its chicks hatch with claws on their wings, to climb branches because they can't fly for sixty to seventy days.
A bird that smells like a pasture and climbs like a lizard.

description:
The hoatzin is the only bird known to ferment leaves in its crop like a cow, which gives it a manure smell.
Its chicks hatch with climbing claws on their wings.
Would you get close to a stinkbird?
first_comment: Which would you rather meet: a stinkbird or a clawed baby bird?
